scripts.agent:check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ingest:edge:now-playing: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; curl -sS -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/tmdb-now-playing" -H "X-CRON-SECRET: $CRON_SECRET" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"'
scripts.ingest:edge:popular: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; curl -sS -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/tmdb-popular-movies" -H "X-CRON-SECRET: $CRON_SECRET" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"'
scripts.ingest:edge:trending: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; curl -sS -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/tmdb-trending-scraper" -H "X-CRON-SECRET: $CRON_SECRET" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"'
scripts.ingest:edge:fresh: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; curl -sS -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/tmdb-fresh-movies" -H "X-CRON-SECRET: $CRON_SECRET" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"'
scripts.ingest:all: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; npm run ingest:collections; npm run ingest:discover; npm run ingest:edge:fresh; npm run ingest:enrich; npm run ingest:images'
scripts.func:invoke:backfill-directors: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; curl -sS -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/backfill-directors?limit=200" -H "X-CRON-SECRET: $CRON_SECRET" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"'
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['.next','.turbo'].forEach((dir)=>fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:10,retryDelay:100})); console.log('✅ Cleared Next.js and Turbopack caches');"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
